units: Client request latency in milliseconds and throughput in requests per second; document count and concurrency explicit.
uncertainty: Workload bars are repetition IQR; coordinator bars are four-session bootstrap CI. No mixed scope or cross-hardware comparisons.
layout: Labels, titles and legend fully visible; no clipping or incorrect units observed.
NVIDIA: Prepared-forward/direct-scoring pairs per second, 15-repetition median/IQR, documents per query fixture; diagnostic paths dashed and labeled. Both panels and legends fully visible. Different y-axis scales explicit; no HTTP or cross-hardware speedup claims.
